description: Follow-up to the Trunk failure classification: verify that remediation worked; do not build another fix here. The 14-day measurement window begins after the named cause fixes and any owner-approved quarantines are deployed, not on a calendar date. The named fixes are the needs of this item: the top recurring causes found by trunk-red-run-triage-20261024 (each cause item that triage links is added to this item's needs before the window starts), plus the two already-known causes trunk-dist-artifact-producer-check-flake-20261022 and ci-amplab-generate-data-timeout-flake (whose fix landed and only needs verification). The earlier latest-attempt figure (59 of 466 runs, 12.7%) is not a first-attempt baseline. Definitions to record before the window opens: numerator = Trunk push runs, counted once per head SHA, whose first attempt ended in failure, timeout or startup failure; denominator = completed Trunk push runs for distinct head SHAs in the window; in-progress or incomplete runs are excluded and reported; duplicate runs for one SHA and missing exact-SHA runs are reported separately; a rerun that passes is not a first-pass success; quarantined tests are listed with the coverage they remove. At about 448 runs in 14 days, fewer than nine failures are needed for below 2%; report counts and an uncertainty interval, not only the percentage. A low rate obtained by missing runs, dropped coverage or quarantine is not an improvement. Failing the target keeps this item open and names the remaining causes; it does not by itself justify broad quarantine without owner approval.
